priorityEffect: No restart and no displacement of F272. The contract is merged into existing Logging, Batch, Generated Domain and Open Git work units to prevent duplicate development.
accepted: Config/Profile/Logging applies to every real executable Main, not libraries or test harnesses
local/dev/test/stg/prod differences must be visible and consumed, not empty profile files
major configuration uses detailed UTF-8 Korean operational comments and one override chain
standalone runtimes provide equivalent Windows/Linux start, stop, restart, status and foreground
graceful shutdown validates PID identity and distinguishes forced termination
Generator owns Generated Domain profiles and optional Batch output
public runtimes preserve the same contract in a Fresh Open Git release
